meta.title: Coach Eddie Williams | Football Coaching — West Virginia
meta.description: Professional football coaching at Webster County High School. Offensive expertise, personalized training, and real results.

about.name: Coach Eddie Williams
about.title: Head Coach
about.bio:
Coach Eddie Williams is a complete football mind with 14 years of experience on both sides of the ball at Webster County High School. A rare coaching profile, Eddie brings depth with expertise in Wing-T offensive systems and 4-2-5 defensive principles — giving athletes a holistic understanding of the game that most coaches simply can't offer.

Whether working with skill positions or defensive personnel, Coach Williams brings an all-encompassing approach to player development that shows up on the scoreboard.

hero.headline: Webster County High School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Complete Football Development
services.description: A full-game coaching program covering both offensive concepts (Wing-T) and defensive principles (4-2-5). Perfect for athletes and coaches who want the complete picture.

services.title: Film Study & Game Planning
services.description: In-depth film breakdown on both sides of the ball — opponent tendencies, scheme adjustments, and game-week preparation.

services.title: Individual Skill Coaching
services.description: One-on-one sessions targeting your specific position needs, from technique to football IQ and mental reps.
